ux_appt_token_per_session.name: ux_appt_token_per_session
ux_appt_token_per_session.where: "appointments"."token_no" IS NOT NULL AND "appointments"."appointment_status" NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'NoShow')

advice_suggestions_list.name: advice_suggestions_list
advice_suggestions_list.default: '["Take medicines as prescribed.","Take adequate rest.","Maintain proper hydration.","Avoid self-medication.","Complete the full course of antibiotics.","Do light exercise daily.","Maintain personal hygiene.","Monitor temperature twice a day.","Avoid smoking and alcohol.","Follow up if symptoms persist."]'::json

dietary_suggestions_list.name: dietary_suggestions_list
dietary_suggestions_list.default: '["Drink boiled water.","Eat small, frequent meals.","Avoid spicy and oily foods.","Include fruits and vegetables.","Stay hydrated throughout the day.","Limit caffeine and alcohol.","Reduce salt and sugar intake.","Include protein-rich foods.","Avoid processed and junk foods.","Maintain a balanced diet."]'::json

ux_lab_report_template_parameters_defaul.name: ux_lab_report_template_parameters_default_override
ux_lab_report_template_parameters_defaul.where: "lab_report_template_parameters"."lab_id" IS NOT NULL AND "lab_report_template_parameters"."source_type" = 'DEFAULT' AND "lab_report_template_parameters"."is_custom" = false AND "lab_report_template_parameters"."base_parameter_id" IS NOT NULL

money_entries_online_ref_ck.name: money_entries_online_ref_ck
money_entries_online_ref_ck.value: "money_entries"."channel" = 'desk' OR "money_entries"."entry_type" NOT IN ('payment', 'refund') OR "money_entries"."gateway_ref" IS NOT NULL

test_catalog_global_name_unique.name: test_catalog_global_name_unique
test_catalog_global_name_unique.where: clinic_id IS NULL AND is_deleted = false

treatment_plan_steps_values_ck.name: treatment_plan_steps_values_ck
treatment_plan_steps_values_ck.value:
"treatment_plan_steps"."seq" >= 1 AND "treatment_plan_steps"."gap_days" >= 0
        AND ("treatment_plan_steps"."duration_minutes" IS NULL OR "treatment_plan_steps"."duration_minutes" > 0)
        AND "treatment_plan_steps"."fee" >= 0

treatment_template_steps_values_ck.name: treatment_template_steps_values_ck
treatment_template_steps_values_ck.value:
"treatment_template_steps"."seq" >= 1 AND "treatment_template_steps"."gap_days" >= 0
        AND ("treatment_template_steps"."duration_minutes" IS NULL OR "treatment_template_steps"."duration_minutes" > 0)
        AND ("treatment_template_steps"."fee" IS NULL OR "treatment_template_steps"."fee" >= 0)

ux_staff_email.name: ux_staff_email
ux_staff_email.where: user_type != 'Patient' AND email IS NOT NULL

ux_patient_mobile.name: ux_patient_mobile
ux_patient_mobile.where: user_type = 'Patient' AND mobile IS NOT NULL
